title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Doing Laundry 😂 A Day in the Life with ADHD #shorts
desc:
A day in the life with ADHD: the laundry loop.

Wash → forget → smells → wash again → forget again. 😂 Can you relate? How many times have YOU rewashed the same load? 👇

Tip: set a phone alarm the second you hit start. Name it "MOVE THE LAUNDRY."

#adhd #adhdlife #adhdbrain #adhdproblems #adhdhumor #shorts #relatable #funny

beats.say: Here's how a normal person does laundry. Wash it. Dry it. Fold it. Put it away. One afternoon.
beats.label: NON-ADHD:

beats.say: Now here's me. I'm out of clean socks. So today's the day.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: Out of socks. Today's the day.

beats.say: Clothes in. Soap in. Start. Look at me. Adulting.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Forty minutes left. I'll just sit down for a second.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: One episode. Okay, the next one starts automatically. That's not my fault.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Why does the hallway smell like a swamp?
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: Why does it smell like a swamp?

beats.say: Oh. Oh no. The laundry. It's been sitting in there wet. For three days.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: No problem. Wash it again. This time I'm watching it.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I watched it for four minutes. Then my phone buzzed.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Swamp smell. Again. Wash number three.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Okay, it's finally dry. Now it lives in the basket. Forever. I just dig through it every morning like it's a treasure chest.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: The basket is the dresser now.

beats.say: And I still don't have clean socks. They're in the washer. Wet.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Here's why. Your brain doesn't feel time going by. Out of sight is out of mind. So the second you hit start, set an alarm on your phone. Name it move the laundry. Let the phone remember for you.
beats.cap2: Tip: set an alarm the second you hit start. Name it MOVE THE LAUNDRY.

beats.say: How many times have you washed the same load? Be honest. Tell me in the comments.
